mapper.sql: select c.clue_id, c.clue_no, c.source_type, c.violation_type, c.person_id, c.related_persons, c.summary, c.detail, c.dept_id, c.handler_id, c.status, c.disposition, c.deadline, c.warn_level, c.is_duplicate, c.duplicate_of, c.source_ref, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, p.name as person_name, d.dept_name as dept_name, u.nick_name as handler_name, case when c.deadline is null then null else datediff(c.deadline, curdate()) end as remain_days from jc_clue c left join jc_person p on p.person_id = c.person_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = c.dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.handler_id
mapper.select: select max(clue_no) from jc_clue where clue_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
where c.del_flag = '0' and c.status not in ('4','5') order by c.deadline asc
mapper.update: update jc_clue set warn_level = #{warnLevel}, update_time = sysdate() where clue_id = #{clueId}
update jc_clue set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where clue_id = #{clueId}
mapper.select: select source_type as name, count(1) as `count` from jc_clue where del_flag = '0' group by source_type
select violation_type as name, count(1) as `count` from jc_clue where del_flag = '0' group by violation_type
select status as name, count(1) as `count` from jc_clue where del_flag = '0' group by status
select warn_level as name, count(1) as `count` from jc_clue where del_flag = '0' group by warn_level
select coalesce(d.dept_name, '未指定') as name, count(1) as `count` from jc_clue c left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = c.dept_id where c.del_flag = '0' group by d.dept_name

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') as name, count(1) as `count` from jc_clue where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{months} month) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') order by name
select count(1) from jc_clue where del_flag = '0' and status not in ('4','5')
select count(1) from jc_clue where del_flag = '0' and status not in ('4','5') and deadline is not null and deadline < curdate()
select count(1) from jc_clue where del_flag = '0' and date_format(create_time, '%Y%m') = date_format(curdate(), '%Y%m')
select count(1) from jc_clue where del_flag = '0'
